title: Anick Resolution for Lawvere Theories from Algebraic Discrete Morse Theory
summary: Inspired by Brown's collapsing method (or discrete Morse theory) to obtain a free resolution of $\bbZ$ over the monoid ring $\bbZ M$, we apply algebraic discrete Morse theory to compute the homology groups of Lawvere theories, which is defined as Tor of a certain module. We reinterpret known partial free resolutions arising from complete term rewriting systems in terms of collapsing of the normalized bar resolution.
